terms.metadataDescription: Terms for using the TechHub learning platform.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: These terms describe how you may use TechHub, including your rights and responsibilities when learning, paying, interacting with content, and using learning support features.

sections.title: Accounts and access
paragraphs: You must provide accurate information when registering and are responsible for protecting your account, password, sessions, and all activity that occurs under your account.
bullets: Do not share your account with others if the learning package or course does not allow it.
Notify TechHub if you discover unauthorized access or suspect that your account has been compromised.

sections.title: Course content
paragraphs: Materials, videos, assignments, questions, learning paths, and content provided by instructors or TechHub are for personal learning use within the platform.
bullets: Do not copy, redistribute, resell, or publicly publish course content without permission.
You may keep your own notes and submissions as long as they do not violate third-party intellectual property rights.

sections.title: Payment and enrollment
paragraphs: Prices, benefits, and access conditions for each course are shown before payment. Transactions may be processed by a payment gateway or service partner integrated with TechHub.
bullets: Course access may depend on payment status, refunds, or the policy of each program.
If a transaction fails or you were charged without enrollment, contact support so the payment can be reconciled.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: You agree to use TechHub in a way that respects other learners, instructors, and the platform's operation.
bullets: Do not post spam, scams, harassment, unlawful content, or content that violates another person's privacy.
Do not attack, scan, exploit vulnerabilities, automate abnormal activity, or disrupt the service.

sections.title: AI features
paragraphs: Some areas of TechHub may use AI to recommend courses, explain content, support learning, or create drafts. AI output is supportive and may need review.
bullets: Do not rely on AI output as the only professional advice for important decisions.
Do not enter sensitive, confidential, or other people's data unless you have the right to process it.

sections.title: Suspension or termination
paragraphs: TechHub may suspend or limit access when it detects a terms violation, security risk, payment fraud, or behavior that affects other users.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: TechHub may update these terms to reflect product, operational, or legal changes. When important changes occur, the platform will try to notify users through an appropriate channel.
If you need support about the Terms of Service, please contact TechHub through the Contact page.

privacy.metadataDescription: How TechHub collects, uses, and protects user data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy explains what data TechHub collects, why it is used, when it may be shared, and what choices you have while using the learning platform.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: TechHub collects information needed to create accounts, operate courses, support payments, personalize learning experiences, and protect the system.
bullets: Account information such as email, username, role, verification status, and profile image if you provide one.
Learning data such as enrolled courses, progress, submissions, quiz results, learning paths, and platform interactions.
Technical data such as device, browser, IP address, login session logs, and security events.
Transaction information at the level needed to confirm payments, reconcile transactions, and support users.

sections.title: How we use information
bullets: Provide, maintain, and improve TechHub's learning features.
Process login, verification, course enrollment, payment, and customer support.
Personalize course recommendations, learning paths, notifications, and content experiences.
Detect fraud, abuse, technical errors, and security risks.

sections.title: Information sharing
paragraphs: TechHub does not sell your personal data. We only share information where necessary to operate the platform or when there is a valid request.
bullets: Infrastructure, hosting, analytics, email, payment, or operational support providers.
Instructors or administrators when needed to handle courses, learning progress, submissions, or support requests.
Competent authorities when required by law or to protect the legitimate rights of TechHub and users.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: TechHub may use cookies or browser storage to maintain login sessions, remember interface and language preferences, and improve performance.

sections.title: Retention and data protection
paragraphs: We retain data for as long as needed for operational, legal, security, and user support purposes. TechHub applies reasonable technical and organizational measures to reduce the risk of unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

sections.title: Your choices
bullets: You can update some account information from your profile or settings page.
You can request support for accessing, correcting, or deleting data within system and regulatory limits.
You can sign out and clear session data from your browser when you are not using a personal device.

sections.title: AI features and learning data
paragraphs: When you use AI features, TechHub may process the content you enter and related learning context to generate responses or recommendations. You should not enter sensitive, confidential, or another person's personal data unless you have permission.

sections.title: Policy updates and contact
paragraphs: This policy may be updated when TechHub changes its product, data processing, or compliance requirements. If important changes occur, we will try to notify you through an appropriate channel.
If you have questions about privacy or personal data, please contact TechHub through the Contact page.

step1.title: Hello! 👋
step1.content: Hi there! I'm Miu - your guide at TechHub. I'll take you on a tour and help you understand TechHub better. Let's go!

step2.title: Learning Area 📺
step2.content: This is the central area of the screen, all lesson content like videos, images, and text will be displayed here {userName} ^^

step3.title: Lesson List 📚
step3.content: Next is an equally important area, this is the list of lessons in this course. You'll interact here frequently to switch lessons and do exercises >_<

step4.title: First Lesson ✅
step4.content: This is your first lesson, when you complete this lesson I'll mark it with a "Green Checkmark" to indicate you've finished it!

step5.title: Locked Lesson 🔒
step5.content: This is lesson 2, by default all lessons at TechHub are locked. When you complete the previous lesson, the next one will automatically unlock. Don't skip the video during learning, or it won't count as completed ^^

step6.title: Notes & Discussion 📝
step6.content: TechHub has a very special feature, which is the "Create Note" function. When studying there will be times you want to take notes, at TechHub you won't need paper and ink for this. Give it a heart <3

step7.title: Q&A Area 💬
step7.content: And this is the area for Q&A and discussion in each lesson. If you find a lesson interesting, feel free to leave a word of encouragement here. I'll be very happy and grateful <3

step1.title: Welcome to AI Chat! 🤖
step1.content: Hello {userName}! I'm TechHub's AI assistant. Let me show you how to use this AI chat page. Let's get started!

step2.title: Workspace tools
step2.content: This area contains the guide and response settings. Open the settings panel when you need to add personal instructions for the AI.

step3.title: Message Input 💬
step3.content: This is where you type your questions for the AI. Feel free to ask anything about programming, courses, or learning paths. The AI will respond instantly!

step4.title: Suggested Questions ⚡
step4.content: If you don't know what to ask, here are some sample questions I suggest for you. Just click on one and it will be sent right away!

step5.title: Conversation History 📚
step5.content: All your conversations will be saved here. You can come back to view them anytime, very convenient right!

step6.title: Create New Chat ✨
step6.content: When you want to start a new topic, click this button to create a new conversation. Have fun chatting with the AI! 💕
